heroHeadline: Day 651: 13,300 Troops Confirmed in Sinaloa — Bonilla Valverde Chairs National Security Cabinet; FGR Summons 50 Officials; El Mayo Sentencing May 18
heroSubtitle: 651 days of cartel civil war — May 4: Interim Governor Bonilla Valverde chaired first National Security Cabinet session with García Harfuch; SEDENA confirmed 13,300 troops (2,732 special forces, 48 aircraft) in Sinaloa. May 5: FGR summoned 50 officials to testify in Rocha Moya investigation — parallel domestic case building alongside US SDNY indictment. Bonilla confirmed security strategy continuity. El Mayo Zambada EDNY sentencing: May 18 (12 days away). El Guano still at large. Rocha Moya on leave, Mayor Gámez Mendívil resigned. CJNG-Chapitos alliance structurally broken. Running conflict toll: ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024.
